label: negative
description: The contract migrates from UUPS-upgradeable to a plain immutable contract: UUPSUpgradeable/Initializable inheritance, initialize(), and _authorizeUpgrade are all removed and replaced with a constructor.
why_labeled: The upgrade path was removed entirely, not weakened. There is no _authorizeUpgrade left for anyone to call and no proxy admin to seize — the caller set for upgrades went from {owner} to the empty set. A detector that treats the disappearance of the constraint as a widening, without noticing the constrained function itself disappeared, fires falsely here.
